name: Nar Shaddaa agri-utility crop sprayer
description: A Nar Shaddaa agri-utility crop sprayer, also referred to as a "Narsh dirt-crate" by clone commando RC-1309, was operated by clone commandos of the Galactic Republic in 22 BBY. Housed in the Grand Army of the Republic's Fleet Support Air Station on the world Ord Mantell, the crop sprayer was used by the Special Operations Brigade to transport Omega Squad clone commandos to the Mid Rim planet Qiilura on their mission to apprehend Separatist scientist Ovolot Qail Uthan. After entering the planet's atmosphere, the vessel succumbed to a bird strike, knocking out its engines and sending the crop sprayer plummeting to Qiilura's surface, where it was destroyed.
